svg.title: Electrical Room — dimensioned architecture baseline
svg.desc: Metric floorplan, circulation, equipment envelopes, overhead routes and provisional section interfaces. Main hall 11 by 16.4 metres; side reserve bay 2.8 by 4.4 metres. See documented unresolved issues.
